findings.claim: Oscar 10-K（FY2025）揭露依賴第三方供應商營運多數通訊、網路與電腦軟硬體；失去供應商可能造成重大中斷。未見地緣（台灣/中國）暴露的搜尋摘要。
findings.excerpt: Some of these third-parties have direct access to our systems in order to provide their services to us and operate the majority of our communications, network, and computer hardware and software.

findings.claim: Oscar 將藥局理賠與網絡管理委外給單一 PBM（CVS/Caremark），並用 AWS、Google Cloud 託管（FY2021 10-K）。
findings.excerpt: Oscar delegates pharmacy claims and network management to a Pharmacy Benefit manager (PBM), CVS/Caremark.
